short_rest.msg:
Spend Hit Dice (d10 + CON +3) to recover HP.
Makeshift Meals: feed 2 creatures, each regains 1 HP.

rest: Short Rest: spend Hit Dice (d10 + CON +3); Makeshift Meals feeds 2 allies
Long Rest: Full HP, both spell slots, half Hit Dice restored (1 of 1)
Hunter's Mark free casts and the Magic Initiate spell reset on a long rest
Prepared spells can be swapped after a long rest

attack: Poison Spray — CON save DC 13
bonus: Hunter's Mark — +1d6 per hit, 2 free casts
Nick (off-hand scimitar, part of the Attack action)
Shape Self — extrude or reabsorb a pseudopod
reaction: Ensnaring Strike (on a hit, if cast)
magic: Fog Cloud — 20 ft heavily obscured
other: Shape Self — take or drop a humanlike shape

reminders: Hunter's Mark is always prepared and you get 2 free casts per long rest. Open with it — it is +1d6 on every hit.
Vex (Shortsword): hit a creature and you have advantage on your next attack against it.
Nick (Scimitar): the off-hand attack rides along with the Attack action — it does not cost your Bonus Action.
Natural Resilience: resistance to acid and poison, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.
Amorphous: you squeeze through a 1-inch gap with nothing worn or carried, and have advantage on grapple checks.
Hold Breath 1 hour, Darkvision 60 ft, and Stealth +6 — you are the scout.
Magic Initiate (Wizard) gives you two cantrips plus one free level-1 casting per long rest.
